items.title: SPHMC initial phase coupling, q=2 proof edge

source.attribution: Fan Chen, Sinho Chewi, Jianfeng Lu and Matthew S. Zhang. ASTIS supplies the measure-theoretic coupling construction.

items.statement: Lemma 4.16 bounds W_{q,M_kappa} between delta_xref tensor N(0,I) and Pi_eta for all q at least 2. Its proof couples momenta identically. This bounded ASTIS proof edge constructs that coupling and proves its exact q=2 Kantorovich cost estimate for any position probability measure with a finite second moment.
assumptions: Position probability law with integrable squared distance to xref.
kappa at least one and the paper's exact phase metric.

obligations.label: Construct the exact same-momentum coupling and bound its q=2 cost
Insert smoothed Gibbs moment and small-gradient reference-point bound (remaining)
Strong-log-concavity concentration for every q at least two (remaining)

bindings.boundary: Only the generic q=2 coupling cost; no Gibbs numeric bound, all-q concentration, Picard history or query cost.

assumption_deltas.source: The paper's Lemma 4.16 uses the smoothed Gibbs target Pi_eta.
assumption_deltas.lean: The coupling-cost theorem accepts any position probability law with an integrable second moment about xref.
assumption_deltas.reason: The identical-momentum coupling uses no Gibbs structure; the specialized numeric estimate is a separate remaining proof edge.

assumption_deltas.source: Lemma 4.16 concludes a W_q estimate for every q at least two.
assumption_deltas.lean: The statement bounds the squared M_kappa Kantorovich cost, corresponding only to q=2.
assumption_deltas.reason: This declaration binds only the explicit same-momentum proof component and does not claim the all-q source obligation.
